== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Look at the intensity on Star Trek CCG World Finalist Ray Lacey's face! Back off, this man's deck is loaded." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
